title: 10-K annual report filing
content: JPMorgan Chase filed its annual 10-K report. Key disclosures include Basel III endgame capital requirements, consumer banking segment performance, and risk management framework updates. Tier 1 capital ratio of 15.3% exceeds regulatory minimums.

title: 8-K earnings release
content: JPMorgan Chase issued an 8-K with Q4 2025 earnings. Net revenue $43.7B, net income $14.0B, EPS $4.81. Return on tangible common equity 21%.
